name: Iron Sword
intro: A great sword crudely forged from iron. It may not be the sharpest blade, but it is reliable and sturdy. It is often used by novice Treasure Hunters during training, helping them find the right feel for exerting force.

name: Ironwood Sword
intro: A two-handed great sword made of ironwood and treated with poison. Although ironwood has a strong affinity for poison, it requires skillful handling to make the most of its power.

name: Sanctuary Sword
intro: A great sword used by the guards of the Holy Church, blessed with divine protection. While it is standard-issue in their ranks, it still offers excellent performance when properly used.

name: Hacking Blade
intro: A heavy cleaver favored by the warriors of the north. Forged from dense northern iron, it is devastating but cumbersome.

name: Giant Iron Axe
intro: A large axe covered in rust. The weight of the iron axehead delivers powerful lethal blows, but its weight makes it a burden to use.

name: Goblin's Trophy
intro: A huge trophy made by the Goblin Legion for their hero. It's hard to imagine a goblin being able to lift this unreasonably large trophy.

name: Iron Machete
intro: A giant, two-handed weapon forged by frontier blacksmiths that better suited for aggressive chopping than a typical two-handed great sword.

name: Sword in Stone
intro: A two-handed weapon covered with hard weathered stone, its blocky shape conceals an ancient blade.

name: Whisperstone
intro: Fragments of the original hammer wielded by the magic guardians of the Black Forest. Although damaged, it retains some of the guardians’ power.

name: Evil Ritual Sword
intro: A great sword found in an ancient underground ruin, it was originally decorative and held by a ceremonial statue. The blade is dull, but carries traces of an ancient evil's power. The bearer may hear the whispers of a profane god.

name: Brass Totem Blade
intro: A giant brass sword found in an ancient underground ruin. It appears to be a ceremonial weapon used for some sort of evil ritual.

name: Rock Hammer
intro: A weapon made by cave dwellers capable of shattering rock with a single blow. Despite their madness, the cave dwellers possess a natural talent for craftsmanship.

name: Bat Knight’s Sword
intro: The two-handed weapon of the Batwing Knight Order. This great sword is made of mithril and enchanted with shadow sorcery, allowing the wielder to blend into the darkness.

name: Corrosive Guardian
intro: A great sword corrupted by evil spirits that possesses great power while also inflicting its wielder with madness.

name: Beast Bone
intro: An exotic great sword forged from the bones of a giant mutated monster. The creature was altered in experiments and reinforced with alchemical substances.

name: Freezing Shard
intro: Huge fragments of un-meltable ice from the polar regions that emit a chilling cold.

name: Rust & Saltpeter
intro: A massive cleaver crudely forged from the layered armor plates of a desert sandbreaker ship. The blade is mixed with a large amount of saltpeter from the Niter Desert, making it prone to explosions during use.

name: Venomous Claw
intro: The giant claw of the Huntspider Matriarch. The venom glands in the claw can be activated to produce deadly poison.

name: Royal Sword
intro: The ceremonial great sword of the Empire, made from refined steel and decorated with meteorite. The sword’s materials grant it an excellent affinity for magic, but the blade is quite dull since it was never intended for the battlefield.

name: Giant's Flame
intro: A great sword crafted long ago from lava by a giant artisan. The sword later came into the hands of an aspiring demon-slayer, who had the artisan carve decorative inscriptions on the previously simple blade.

name: Dungeon Guard’s Axe
intro: A giant axe made from magical crystals that originally belonged to a magic guardian. This powerful automaton was ordered by its summoner to kill any thieves attempting to steal the hidden treasures. The axe still bears the magical power of its former master.

name: Black Gold Hammer
intro: This hammer appears to have been crafted by cave dwellers and is made of rare ore imbued with earth magic. It can generate powerful shock waves by striking the ground.

name: Crystal Scale Blade
intro: A great sword made of dragon scales and crystals containing magical energy. The blade’s crystals store the power of both dragons and lightning.

name: Monolith Maul
intro: In the mountains of Riyado, unstable magical currents affect the rocks of Rhea, endowing them with strong but unstable magical forces which draw various creatures into the region.

name: Mechanical Blade Axe
intro: A peculiarly large axe crafted by a mysterious artisan. The blade consists of layered mechanical blades that can be launched with a powerful swing.

name: Blade of Soul
intro: A great sword forged with unstable Soulstones, which constantly emit chaotic soul energy and inflame resentment among the dead.

name: Flame Knight’s Sword
intro: Legend has it that after defeating a powerful flame demon, the demon-slaying warrior wore scorched black armor which earned him the title “Knight of Flames.” The great sword, which he crafted from the core of the flame demon's eyeball, is one of his most famous weapons and contains intense fiery power.

name: Frozen Blade
intro: A large sword made from eternal ice mined from deep within the tundra. This un-melting ice contains powerful arctic energy and can quickly freeze the air to form ice blades.

name: Blazing Blade
intro: A large sword forged in a volcano from molten lava. Its unstable core is ready to erupt with the fury of a volcano.

name: Destroyer
intro: A special weapon collected by spirits in another realm that contains a complex magical mechanism capable of unleashing great power.

name: Demonic Imperial Shard
intro: An old Imperial great sword that has been corroded by demonic flesh. Although the sword's edge has been broken in battle, it remains defiantly sharp.

name: Demon Slayer
intro: A huge and heavy black iron great sword that has slain countless demons. The weapon is loathed and feared by demonic forces.

name: Commander's Great Axe
intro: Rumored to be the great axe wielded by a powerful demon general. Its blade holds a special power that inspires the warriors of their legion.

name: Ripper
intro: A giant chainsaw blade forged from Enchanted Brass and Ether-powered, capable of easily slicing through tough demon carapaces.

name: Twisted Great Sword
intro: A twisted great sword forged from the corrupted mana of Ethereals. When wielded properly, it channels and unleashes a surge of powerful Ethereal runic magic.

name: Ultimate Broadsword
intro: A crystal great sword empowered by life itself.

name: Hero’s Epic
intro: This powerful blade was lost when its owner’s family fell from grace. This once-famous sword was passed down to the family’s most dedicated swordsmen for generations. The spirits of each wielder reside within the sword.

name: Flame Giant’s Axe
intro: This massive axe is rumored to have been forged by a mysterious giant blacksmith from the mountains of the Red-Jade Empire. The artisan is a disciple of the Flame God, and although his creations lack finesse, they contain immense strength.

name: Sword of Justice
intro: A great sword filled with holy power, it is said to be the sacred sword given to a valiant warrior by the Apostle of the Holy Light.

name: Chaos Destroyer
intro: Forged with the power of the Chaos God via a corrupted high-density Soul Crystal, it shatters anything it strikes.

name: Iron Sword
intro: A simple and practical sword and shield crafted primarily from iron. Often used by novice treasure hunters for real combat practice, the shield is not particularly sturdy but provides a sense of security.

name: Forest Sword
intro: A sword and shield made of ironwood. The ironwood in the sword is imbued with seeds from forest-dwelling monsters, which can grow quickly when infused with magic.

name: Sanctuary Sword
intro: The blessed sword and shield used by the guards of the Holy Church. Although they are standard-issue weapons, they can perform remarkably well when used properly.

name: Cooking Utensils
intro: A cook who does not wish to kill is not a good bounty hunter.

name: Steel Short Lance
intro: A modified polearm turned into an excellent weapon for breaking through defenses.

name: Enhanced Blade
intro: The beloved blade of a novice Treasure Hunter that has been imbued with poisonous magical energy.

name: Goblin Rogue’s Dagger
intro: Goblins always provide thrilling surprises.

name: Wood Guardian
intro: A shield and hand axe formed from the vines of a magical guardian. Made of simple stone and wood, but quite sturdy and lightweight due to the residual magic of the guardian.

name: Magic Apprentice
intro: A weapon invented by an eccentric Rhea-Doran mage apprentice. Rather than being based on true ingenuity, it's more of a playful design invented due to the apprentice's sheer boredom with the overly thick spellbooks that mages need to master.

name: Imperial Guardian
intro: The standard-issue weapon of the shield soldiers in the Imperial legions. The huge square shields can be firmly planted on the ground, providing a reassuringly stable defense in a phalanx formation.

name: Black Iron Hammer
intro: A black iron war hammer. It not only deals blunt damage upon a heavy hit, but the sharp irregular spikes on the hammer can also cause armor-piercing and tear damage, leaving the enemy with wounds that are difficult to heal.

name: Wildling
intro: A barbarian weapon from the edge of the wilderness. It looks primitive, but is extremely strong and durable.

name: Corrosive Slayer
intro: A sword and shield corrupted by evil, they devour the souls of the creatures they strike.

name: Imperial Sword
intro: The standard weapon of the Imperial Guards, exquisitely designed and reliable in combat.

name: Barbarian Bone Axe
intro: This bone axe, commonly wielded by the border tribes, can be used for both chopping and hurling.

name: Venom Thorn Lance
intro: Crafted from a Venomous Thorned Beast, this short spear still retains living toxic thorns, capable of producing a continuous stream of deadly venom.

name: Great Fisherman
intro: Take up the harpoon and become the true king of the fishermen!

name: Monument of the Rock
intro: A strange weapon found in the ruins with an especially bizarre and ruggedly heavy "shield."

name: Sand-Piercing Lance
intro: A short lance crafted from the scales and bones of a Treasure Anglerfish. In addition to regular combat, it can also assist its owner to burrow into sand and soil.

name: Royal Sword
intro: The ceremonial sword of the Empire, made from refined steel and decorated with meteorite. The sword’s materials grant it an excellent affinity for magic, but the blade is quite dull since it was never intended for the battlefield.

name: Ironforge Battler
intro: The standard sword and shield of the Ironforge Knights, with a massive tower shield that seems to flow with molten iron.

name: Fortress Battle Axe
intro: A double-edged battle axe and a huge shield made by dwarves from meteorite that requires great strength to wield freely.

name: Captain's Legacy
intro: The unique weapon of a once-famous Treasure Hunter known as the Captain. In memory of his first icebreaker ship, the Captain crafted this sword and shield from the ship's anchor and helm. They are said to contain the spirit of danger and adventure.

name: Cavalry Short Lance
intro: A short spear modified from an Imperial cavalry lance. A light weapon that can be easily used in infantry combat, the steel-tipped spear has formidable piercing power.

name: Crystal Scale Shard
intro: A sword and shield made of dragon scales and crystals containing magical energy. The blade’s crystals store the power of both dragons and lightning.

name: Parasitic Short Lance
intro: A weapon that has become the host to a bizarre otherworldly creature; the person wielding the weapon will also become a host.

name: Glacier Lance
intro: Crafted from sharp shards of un-melting ice, this short spear can unleash powerful ice elemental energy when infused with magic.

name: Legion Javelin
intro: This weapon is wielded by the soldiers of the Storm Legion, a mercenary group that worships the Storm God Kalion. The legion is renowned for their expertise in javelins and other throwing weapons.

name: Sword of Void
intro: A sword and shield made from unique materials able to create a miniature black hole. Although some believe it originates from another dimension, it is most likely to be the result of research by a mysterious magical organization in Riyado.

name: Hammer of the Master Craftsman
intro: It is said that this iron hammer belonged to a legendary master craftsman, who used it to forge many wondrous creations.

name: Sword of Soul
intro: A sword and shield forged with unstable Soulstones, which constantly emit chaotic soul energy and inflame resentment among the dead.

name: Malevolent Gaze
intro: A weapon set filled with evil thoughts. Embedded in the shield is the eyeball of a powerful demon, which seems to still be alive. Those who stare into the eye may find them selves overwhelmed with otherworldly terror.

name: Demon Bone
intro: A weapon set forged from the remains of a giant demon. The demon’s rage still flows in the weapon, and one can sense the evil within from a single glance.

name: Dragon's Wrath
intro: A weapon set crafted from materials recovered from a powerful fire dragon. The dragon-shaped shield can breathe dragon fire at any time. Fire dragons are the most ferocious and irritable among all dragon, very similar to fire mages.

name: Frost Sword
intro: A weapon set made from eternal ice mined from deep within the tundra. This un-melting ice contains powerful arctic energy and can quickly freeze the air to form ice blades.

name: Star Steel Sword
intro: A weapon set forged from special meteorite steel from another realm. This material seems to have a special reaction to magical energy and is capable of creating a special barrier that blocks any damage.

name: Rock Thunder Lance
intro: Forged from a unique mineral, this short lance can harness the surrounding electrical fields when infused with magic. After gathering electricity, the spear becomes incredibly light.

name: Kalion's Javelin
intro: Legend has it that when the Storm God Kalion took the form of a brave warrior, this javelin was his weapon of choice. It is capable of gathering immense lightning bolts to strike down enemies.

name: Demon Slayer
intro: A weapon once held by a powerful demon-slaying hero. It is said to be the weapon he was carrying when he disappeared. The battle axe is coated in the blood and anger of the thousands of demons he slaughtered.

name: Eternal Frost
intro: Rumor has it that this weapon was crafted by a renowned craftsman of the empire and forged from high-purity un-meltable ice ore. When infused with magical power, it generates a potent force of ice.

name: Nightmare Shard
intro: A grotesque weapon composed of unstable magical energy, constantly emanating eerie mana.

name: Twisted Blade
intro: An uncanny sword and shield forged from the corrupted mana of Ethereals. It manipulates Ethereal runic magic via its own corrupted mana to sustain its form.

name: Brave Soul
intro: A giant sturdy tower shield that is said to be inhabited by the spirit of a hero in its central gemstone.

name: Hero's Lance
intro: A short spear held by a famous demon-slaying hero when he rose to fame. It is said that with this weapon, he pierced the eye of a powerful demon general and subsequently repelled the demonic forces.

name: Chaos Blade
intro: Forged with the power of the Chaos God via a corrupted high-density Soul Crystal, it wields boundless chaotic energy.

name: Cursed Blade
intro: A weapon wielded by a cursed mercenary. The mercenary appears to have grown accustomed to their corruption and fights using the power of the curse itself.

name: Oak Staff
intro: A staff made from simple oak and basic enchantments, it is cost-effective with acceptable performance. Very suitable for beginners.

name: Ironwood Snake
intro: A staff crafted from ironwood that has been nourished by magic over time. It has undergone a high grade fire enchantment and boasts significant magical performance.

name: Noble Staff
intro: This ceremonial staff is popular among Imperial mages as it places more emphasis on aesthetics than functionality. The large magic crystal on the staff can harness the power of lightning.

name: Sanctuary Staff
intro: The blessed staff carried by the sanctuary's church guards. Although they are standard-issue weapons, they can perform remarkably well when used properly.

name: Sapphire & Copper Staff
intro: A staff that uses a magic crystal from the Riyado border mountains as its mana core. The volatile magical energy within can summon lightning.

name: Frost Whisper
intro: A staff that can continuously convert the infused magic into the power of frost. It is rumored to be wielded by the apprentices who worship the God of Ice and Snow.

name: Poisonous Spore Wand
intro: A staff made from a living venomous tree nourished by magic. Striking forcefully can release its highly poisonous spores.

name: Sacrificial Staff
intro: A voodoo staff smuggled from a border region's witchcraft society. It has gained tremendous toxic power through the sacrifice of souls.

name: Glimmering Staff
intro: A well-crafted staff that possesses great potential, even though it seems not to have strong magical aptitude.

name: Champion's Token
intro: The goblins have made multiple trophies for their warriors. This trophy is clearly lighter than most others, and what's hidden inside is unknown, but when waved, it releases magical energy.

name: Plant Staff
intro: Mutant plants are always suitable materials for weapon crafting. By infusing them with magic to maintain the vitality of the plant, the staff becomes serviceable and strong.

name: Supply Beacon Staff
intro:
The Treasure Hunters Guild has designed and crafted this staff. Once infused with magic, it can send a signal to transport a supply crate from the Guild's emergency supply warehouse directly to your location! 
“I’m not really sure what’s in those crates, though.” — A guild warehouse manager who prefers to remain anonymous.

name: Eye of Corrosion
intro: A staff inlaid with the eye of a demon that brings calamity. The demon's eye seems still alive and is able to turn anyone who gazes upon it to ashes.

name: Blessing Wings
intro: The staff used by a famous nomadic exorcist in the past. This exorcist specialized in using lightning magic, believing that its power could dispel evil.

name: Evil Gaze
intro: A staff crafted using the eye of a malevolent otherworldly creature as the magical medium of the staff. The Evil Eye can release a blast capable of dissolving solid armor.

name: Demon's Jewel
intro: A staff made from a green gemstone from the demon realm. It holds significant magical power.

name: Pure Crystal Wand
intro: A staff that utilizes high-purity un-melting ice as a magic medium, which a common commodity in Riyado.

name: Experimental Catalyst
intro: A special staff modified by the evil alchemist Eugene, equipped with a special mechanism that can produce a large amount of highly toxic alchemical substances.

name: Imperial Staff
intro: The standard staff of the Imperial Legion's junior mages, the red magic crystal can channel the power of flames.

name: Corroded Cleric's Scepter
intro: A priest who once protected villagers was devoured by the power of a malicious god. His scepter also became an instrument of evil that could control the souls of the dead.

name: Devourer Staff
intro: A staff crafted from materials harvested from an adult Treasure Anglerfish.This staff can also attract other juvenile Anglerfish.

name: Mortar Staff
intro: Rather than channeling magic to cast ordinary spells for attacks, this staff might be faster for physical spellcasting.

name: Cursed Staff
intro: This misshapen staff has a terrible power sealed within, capable of inflicting vicious curses on nearby enemies.

name: Voodoo Cultist’s Wand
intro: A strange voodoo staff smuggled from a border witchcraft society. An unidentifiable creature's skull hangs from the staff, in which a crystal is embedded.

name: Dragon’s Thunder Core
intro: A staff made from the heart of a thunder dragon. Only a mage with robust magical power can control this magic. The border mountains of Riyado contain a large number of crystals infused with magic, as well as dragons that have grown huge by devouring these crystals.

name: Reaper’s Prototype
intro: One of the weapons held by a Weapon Master. When swung, flames erupt from the head of the staff. Although modified from a staff, this weapon is actually closer to a large scythe.

name: Fire Crystal Staff
intro: Such highly concentrated crystals of flame magic are not common and can only be formed in extremely hot environments.

name: Profound Crystal Staff
intro: The magical medium of this staff is a rare highly-concentrated frost crystal. Only a high-level magical workshop could possibly construct such a magnificent design.

name: Thunder Crystal Staff
intro: A staff enchanted by a lightning spirit and gifted to his favorite mage. In addition to the lightning spirit's magic power, the staff also seems to be imbued with a great deal of emotion.

name: Orb of Void
intro: A staff made from unique materials that is able to create a miniature black hole. Although some believe it originates from another dimension, it is most likely to be the result of research by a mysterious magical organization in Riyado.

name: Mysterious Teleportation Staff
intro:
This staff is a teleportation key to one of the Riad military warehouses. It can open a portal to transport stored supplies from the warehouse. 
"Let’s just hope no one notices us borrowing a few things."

name: Frostbind Staff
intro: This experimental device is powered by the essence of Ice Spirits and is capable of channeling formidable frost magic.

name: Core of the Storm
intro: The staff was once wielded by a famous guardian mage of the Riyado Guardian Council. It is said that this powerful mage could control storms themselves.

name: Lava Wand
intro: Made from a magma core and blessed by the God of Flames, a powerful mage can use this staff to control the power of volcanoes.

name: Soul Vision
intro: A staff made with a chaotic Soulstone as its medium. Due to the interweaving of various powers within the Soulstone, the caster cannot predict which power will be called upon.

name: Luna's Staff
intro: A powerful staff made using the legendary moonstone as a magical medium. The moonstone possesses immeasurable power and can wrap its master with ice for protection.

name: Apollo's Staff
intro: A powerful staff forged from fragments of the legendary sunstone. The sunstone has incredible strength that can instantly incinerate enemies.

name: Dark Disaster
intro: A staff formed from the entwining and twisting of contrasting black and white vines. The tangled collision of malevolent forces and vital energies within it generates a formidable power of calamity.

name: Nightmare Vision
intro: A grotesque staff composed of unstable magical energy, possessing powerful mana with chaotic elemental attributes.

name: Twisted Staff
intro: A twisted staff forged from the corrupted mana of Ethereals. It can forcibly channel Ethereal runic power through a unique malevolent mana.

name: Spirit Stone
intro: Rumors from the Riyado mountains speak of a powerful spirit stone that has condensed the mightiest lightning and chaotic magical energies. It is said that this staff was crafted using fragments of this spirit stone as a magical conduit.

name: Meteor Power
intro: Make a wish, and you shall see a shooting star!

name: Scion of the Lord
intro: A staff infected by the larvae of the Demon Lord, capable of harnessing terrifying demonic power. It is said that excessive use of this power will eventually turn the user into a breeding ground for demonic offspring.

name: Chaos Staff
intro: Forged with the power of the Chaos God via a corrupted high-density Soul Crystal, it incinerates all with chaotic magic and hellfire.

name: Mystical Camera
intro: Flowed into this world from another realm via the Ethereal Vault. It appears to be a device for capturing images. Though it can no longer record due to a lack of consumables, it can still emit an intense flash of light.

name: Elderwood Cane
intro: A mysterious staff that appeared alongside a mage from another world, its magical power seems to change as it levels up.

name: Staff of Conjuring
intro: A mysterious staff that appeared alongside a mage from another world, its magical power seems to change as it levels up.

name: Riyado Tracker Staff
intro: Exclusive staff of the Riyado Council of Guardians' agents, boasting exceptional spellcasting performance.

name: Standard Short Musket
intro: A standard musket, its shorter barrel provides decent mid-to-close range suppressive power.

name: Lizardman Musket
intro: The sand in the Saltpeter Desert can be refined into highly flammable and explosive materials, and the Lizardfolk marauders who occupy this area have used it to develop specialized firearms.

name: Standard Long Musket
intro: A newer type of musket modified from the early standard model, featuring a longer barrel for greater range and accuracy.

name: Bamboo Musket
intro: A crude long-barreled musket made from bamboo. Firing too aggressively may cause the barrel to explode!

name: Ironwood Cannon
intro: A crude musket made of ironwood. The barrel surprisingly is sturdy and durable.

name: Goblin Cannon
intro: Discovered among discarded weapons left behind by the goblin army, this crude cannon shows that goblins have a special talent for cobbling things together.

name: Hand of the Wood Spirit
intro: A short musket crafted from the broken branches of the wood spirits, which makes it capable of channeling their power.

name: Polar Musket
intro: A standard-issue firearm designed and manufactured by northern craftsmen. It utilizes a type of polar-specific cold gas nitrate as the propellant for its ammunition, and the gun itself always emanates an unpleasant chill.

name: Sniper Long Musket
intro: A new long-barreled musket modified by hunters. It has better range and sniping capabilities than short-barreled guns, allowing for long-range targeting of dangerous prey.

name: River Monster Musket
intro: This musket's barrel is made from the venomous organ of a rare toxic fish.It can continuously spray large amounts of venom.

name: Steam Blaster
intro: A steam-powered hand cannon crafted by master artisans. It has a more stable kinetic system compared to gunpowder-based weapons, but the complex mechanism is prone to damage.

name: Desert Marauder
intro: A large number of explosive cacti grow in the Saltpeter Desert. These volatile plants can be turned into various crude firearms.

name: Desert Cactus
intro: The strongest cacti bloom with the purest flower.

name: Alchemical Launcher
intro: A musket modified from the enormous syringe of the evil alchemist Eugene. Stores unstable alchemical substances that can be fired at enemies.

name: Ruststeel Cannon
intro: It is said that this hand cannon was modified by Lizardfolk from a sandbreaker ship cannon they seized. The thick rust-covered barrel is filled with unstable gunpowder.

name: Noble's Musket
intro: The ceremonial musket of the Empire, forged with a steel barrel and decorated with meteorite. Due to its composition, it has excellent magical affinity and can fire electrically charged bullets.

name: Steel Cutter
intro: A specially modified musket, more practical for close quarters combat than for long range battles.

name: Noble's Long Musket
intro: The Empire's new ceremonial musket, modified with a new long barrel. It can fire electrically enchanted bullets with extended range.

name: Bass Horn
intro: Listen to that alluring bass!

name: Modified Cannon Type VII
intro: A special hand cannon designed and calibrated by a demi-human known as the Weapon Master. It boasts excellent combat performance.

name: Cannon of Gravity
intro: A special hand cannon made of unique materials, capable of creating powerful void gravity fields. Although some believe it originates from another dimension, it is most likely to be the result of research by a mysterious magical organization in Riyado.

name: Steam Rapid-Fire Musket
intro: An experimental steam-powered musket created by master craftsmen, designed for rapid fire. This represents the first model of an entirely new type of musket!

name: Millet Burner
intro:
"Would you like to have some corn? It's delicious."   
"Don't want any? How about some popcorn then?"

name: Crystal Dragon's Head
intro: A musket crafted from the carapace of a thunder dragon. It is able to convert the heat generated from firing into chaotic lightning energy!

name: Volcanic Blaster
intro: A musket forged from eternally burning volcanic rock. When infused with magic, it can unleash the power of a volcanic eruption to blast enemies away.

name: Glacier Launcher
intro: An experimental magic-powered musket crafted by the artisans of Ryador. It uses eternal ice as its core and fires ice-elemental magic bullets.

name: Dragon Blaster
intro: A powerful musket powered by the energy of a flame dragon. It can convert the heat generated by firing into a blast of dragon fire.

name: Magic Crystal Focus
intro: A special musket designed by a mysterious magical society in Ryador. Though it operates like a musket, it is actually a magical device that focuses and fires the energy of magic crystals.

name: Devouring Beast
intro: Don't be fooled by its appearance. This is a world-devouring monster!

name: Magic Coil
intro: An experimental magic-powered launcher designed by several researchers in Ryador. It can fire energy beams to bombard enemies.

name: Soul Cannon
intro: A hand cannon powered by an unstable Soulstone that is capable of unleashing a torrent of vengeful souls.

name: Alien Fishbone
intro: In the past, there was a Treasure Anglerfish that wished to devour every living creature it saw. Even in death, its hunger remains.

name: Suppressor
intro: A hand cannon forged from Enchanted Brass, using ether as activating power to fire projectiles. It can unleash a rapid barrage for suppressive fire against enemies.

name: Spine of the Fallen Dragon
intro: A musket forged from the remains of an Fallen Dragon. It is said the dragon was once the servant of a wicked god, and that its intense malevolent thoughts still cling to this weapon.

name: Golden Destroyer
intro: Fear stems from insufficient firepower!

name: Evil Energy Cannon
intro: A musket driven by the power of primordial chaos and fueled by life energy. Whoever pulls the trigger will burn away their own life and sanity, unleashing ruin upon their enemies.

name: Artisan's Cannon
intro: A heavy musket crafted by master artisans in the past, built to be solid and durable.

name: Fish Hunter
intro: Grab your fish musket and become the true Fisher King!

name: Mutated Thorn Musket
intro: A long-barreled musket enveloped and corrupted by thorny creatures. Influenced by their power, it can fire special venomous bullets.

name: Savage Destroyer
intro: A rough short-barreled musket, rumored to have been used by a notorious bandit leader on the frontier.

name: Spiked Launcher
intro: A crude launching device made by scavengers, capable of firing improvised spike grenades.

name: Experimental Multi-Barrel Musket
intro: An experimental prototype rapid-fire musket developed by master craftsmen. It achieves rapid fire using alternating barrels.

name: Stings of the Lord
intro: A musket made from the flesh and fangs of a powerful demon lord. While corrupted by demonic energy this weapon grants its wielder terrifying powers.

name: Dual Iron Blades
intro: A pair of daggers made from ordinary iron ore. These are some of the most common weapons used by adventurers.

name: Ironwood Blades
intro: A pair of short blades made from poisoned ironwood. The deadly seeds within the ironwood can also become powerful weapons in battle.

name: Sanctuary Daggers
intro: The blessed double-edged swords held by the guards of the Holy Church's cathedral. Although they are standard-issue weapons, they can perform remarkably well when used properly.

name: Dual Iron Axes
intro: A pair of heavy iron axes, they sacrifice speed for destructive power.

name: Dual Iron Hooks
intro: Iron hooks covered with rust spots that emit the faint smell of blood.

name: Meat Mincer
intro: Ah…Fresh meat!

name: Giant Scissors
intro: A pair of huge scissors specifically made for clearing mutant plants.

name: Ritual Copper Hammers
intro: A special weapon used in certain magical ceremonies in Rhea. The hammer’s core is embedded with the power of lightning, which becomes unstable when activated.

name: Holy Mithril daggers
intro: A pair of daggers forged from mithril. Though mithril itself holds no magic, it has great affinity for enchantments. This mithril dagger set is blessed and can channel holy light to attack.

name: Reversed-Blade Cutter
intro: A pair of uniquely shaped double-edged swords that test the user's skill. Their special reversed blades that provides an excellent slicing effect.

name: River Masters
intro: Even fish should not be without dreams.

name: Dual Corrosive Blades
intro: A pair of dual blades corrupted by evil spirits that allow the wielder to unleash the power of darkness.

name: Barbarian Bone Spike
intro: The bone spike favored by the border tribes is suitable for both combat and hunting. Can also be thrown.

name: Frostbite Blades
intro: Lightweight dual blades made from shards of un-melting ice.

name: Sand-Gliding Fin
intro: A pair of blades crafted from the sharp fins of a Treasure Anglerfish. The unique scales of the Treasure Anglerfish not only allow these blades to effortlessly cut through enemies, but also enable skilled wielders to easily burrow through sand and stone.

name: Witchcraft Bone Stings
intro: Fish bones corroded by evil power, which still bear some strange bite marks.

name: Noble Daggers
intro: The ceremonial daggers of the Empire, made from refined steel and adorned with meteorite. Due to their composition, the blades possess excellent magical affinity and are capable of channeling lightning.

name: Dual Demon Blades
intro: Dual blades forged from demonic materials that produce a sound like a demon's growl when swung.

name: Black Iron Hammers
intro: A pair of roughly-made black iron spiked maces that are powerful but also incredibly heavy and require great skill to wield.

name: Amber Blades
intro: These blades are made of amber containing a thousand-year-old venomous bug and can unleash powerful poison magic when swung.

name: Imperial Guard’s Blades
intro: The ceremonial dual blades of the Imperial Guard. Made from refined steel and meteorite with an imposing affinity for lightning magic.

name: Purity & Justice
intro: An old pair of swords from the Red-Jade Kingdom, which, despite their rusty appearance, contain a powerful force sealed within.

name: Monolith Shatter
intro: In the mountains at the Rhea border, the rocks contain powerful and volatile magical energy.

name: Lightning Edges
intro: Elves generally do not use physical weapons, so these dual blades must have been forged by elves for the humans they trust.

name: Razorfeather Blades
intro: Dual blades crafted from the feathers of a griffin. The griffin's feathers are as sharp as steel and possess powerful regenerative abilities.

name: Slayer Rapier
intro: A pair of rapiers forged specifically for hunting monsters. They seek out the aura of demons for easier tracking and slaying.

name: Soul Shards
intro: Dual blades made from unstable Soulstones that house the power of chaotic souls.

name: Dual Maces
intro: Black iron clubs with dull spikes which, despite their heavy weight, can be swung quickly to strike enemies with devastating force.

name: Ice of the Frost Sun
intro: Dual blades crafted by a legendary craftsman from un-melting ice, which can freeze the air when swung.

name: Flame of the Full Moon
intro: These dual blades were forged from the lava of a volcano by a legendary craftsman and can burn enemies with flames when swung.

name: Wicked Steel Blades
intro: A pair of weapons flowing with powerful demonic energy infused at the time of forging.

name: Halberd Shard-Blades
intro: Fragments of an old-style Imperial knight's halberd corroded by demons. The broken pieces of the weapon and shattered demonic flesh once bore witness to a forgotten battle between the weapon's owner and a vile demon.

name: Berserker Blood Axe
intro: There is a legend in the borderlands about a brave warrior who, in defense of his village, battled a demon army for three days and nights until he was finally slain in combat.

name: Storm Axe
intro: A pair of battle axes blessed by the Storm God. "Wield them like a storm, and summon thunderbolts to vanquish evil!”

name: Puppet Bear Claws
intro: A pair of plush bear paws that seem to control their wielder. Though deceptively soft to the touch, a strike from these claws lands with the bone-shattering force of a real black bear's swipe.

name: Dance of Ice & Fire
intro: Ice and fire, extreme cold and intense heat – the two extreme powers reflect each other’s endless potential.

name: Black & White
intro: One cuts for good, one cuts for evil. Between them, there is balance.

name: Chaos & Deceit
intro: Forged with the power of the Chaos God via a corrupted high-density Soul Crystal, its victims will be torn apart with malicious force.

name: Wooden Hunting Bow
intro: A light wooden bow, easy for beginners to use.

name: Ironwood Ranger Bow
intro: A longbow made from ironwood that has a strong affinity for magic.

name: Sanctuary Bow
intro: A sanctified bow carried by the guards of the Holy Church. Standard-issue, but good quality.

name: Hard Brass Bow
intro: A composite bow made of copper ore. Heavy, but durable and high-performing.

name: Emerald Mechanism Bow
intro: A mechanical bow made for hunters by Imperial craftsmen that is capable of quickly setting traps.

name: Rose Vine
intro: A bow woven from magically nurtured poisonous rose vines that is capable of inflicting poison.

name: Vine Bow
intro: A longbow twisted from the vines of a wood spirit that still possesses magical powers.

name: Corrosive Wings
intro: A longbow made from the wings of a beast. Lightweight and imbued with a portion of the beast's power.

name: Lightning-Quick Bow
intro: A magical longbow created by the craftsmen of Riyado after studying lightning spirits. It can shoot swift electrified arrows.

name: Arrow of Evil Charm
intro: A famous thief's bow, rumored to never miss its wicked targets.

name: Alchemy Syringe
intro: A longbow crafted by the evil alchemist Eugene that uses mechanisms to quickly create various alchemical potions.

name: Corrupt-Bone Bow
intro: A bow constructed from the bones and flesh of mutated monsters from an abandoned village it is filled with intense grudges and necrotic energies.

name: Imperial Bow
intro: The standard-issue longbow of the Imperial Legion it is solidly built and high-performing.

name: Devourer Bow
intro: A longbow crafted from materials harvested from an adult Treasure Anglerfish. The special pheromones on this longbow attract juvenile Anglerfish.

name: Venomous Hunting Bow
intro: A longbow forged from materials harvested from the Huntspider Matriarch. By infusing magic to activate its venom glands, its arrows can be laced with the Matriarch's deadly venom.

name: Wooden Strong Bow
intro: A strong bow made from lightning-attracting spirit wood. Its arrows are capable of summoning lightning.

name: Ritual Longbow
intro: An ornate ceremonial longbow of the Imperial Guard. It was not designed for combat, but can shoot a splendid volley of arrows.

name: Magic Crystal Bow
intro: A longbow enhanced with the power of Soulstones that enables chaos and soul magic in its arrows.

name: Scarlet Thorns
intro: A longbow made from thorns watered with the blood of demons that induces a frenzied state in its wielder.

name: Compound Bow Mk XI
intro: A bow used by a master smith that is continuously modified for exceptional performance.

name: Bow of Gravity
intro: A bow made from unique materials able to create a miniature black hole. Although some believe it originates from another dimension, it is most likely to be the result of research by a mysterious magical organization in Riyado.

name: Lightning Arc
intro: A longbow created by lightning spirits using their thunderous power. Probably made by the spirits and gifted to trusted humans.

name: Polar Hunter
intro: It is said that there is a group of mysterious monster hunters in the polar regions who excel at using light bows crafted from un-meltable ice ore to hunt monsters.

name: Ghost Fox Bow
intro: The legendary longbow of a famous demon hunter from the far eastern island nation of Ryosen. It has been reshaped by the power of the Phantom. It can channel the demon hunter's obsession into phantom energy and slay any monster in its path.

name: Demon Shooter
intro: A longbow comprised of demon flesh. Its power manifests in unholy screeches when it fires arrows.

name: Lava Striker
intro: A heavy bow reinforced with the power of lava that can shoot fiery arrows.

name: Horns of the Mad Bull
intro: A mighty bow made from the horns of siege beasts that can shake the ground with a full-force shot.

name: Arrow of Ice
intro: A strong bow modified with un-melting ice that freezes targets with its arrows.

name: Spore Wooden Longbow
intro: A bow made from corrupted mutant plants. Its spores cause corrosive mists.

name: Wind Strong Bow
intro: An ancient elven bow that ended up in the hands of Ethereal spirits, capable of shooting powerful volleys that fall like sudden rainstorms.

name: Golden Battler
intro: A specially modified longbow, made of orichalcum and meteorite that offers exceptional performance.

name: Nightfall
intro: A longbow tainted by an eerie substance. Initially, researchers speculated it might be the flesh of a rare demon, but recent theories suggest the corruption stems from the very residue of the Nightmare lurking deep within the castle.

name: Nightmare Echo
intro: A grotesque longbow composed of unstable magical energy.

name: Deep-Sea Gaze
intro: A longbow obtained after communication with a mysterious otherworldly entity. Looking directly into its eyes is not advised.

name: Holy Wood Bow
intro: A special longbow crafted from holy wood. Simple in appearance, but blessed with unfathomable divine power.

name: Misled Lord Bow
intro: A longbow cursed by the power of primordial chaos. Every arrow it looses forges the wielder's life and sanity into raw destructive power.

name: Iron Turbo Lance
intro: The earliest functioning version of the turbo lance features a standardized vortex furnace to ensure weapon stability, making it easy to handle for novices.

name: Ironwood Lance
intro: Constructed from ironwood, this turbo lance is powered by magical mechanisms rather than the standard steam furnace.

name: Sanctuary Lance
intro: The new standard-issue weapon for the Holy Church's guards, driven by a standard steam furnace but blessed with holy magic.

name: Knight’s Lance
intro: Forged from sturdy plate material, this turbo lance offers both defensive and offensive capabilities, though it is quite heavy.

name: Iron Spine Lance
intro: A bombardment-specialized turbo lance that incorporates a magic conversion mechanism within the vortex furnace to create powerful magical blasts.

name: Pumpkin Stove
intro: In another world, there was once a sentient pumpkin that had adventures with a hero. Stories of their journeys spread across the continent, and this unique furnace gun was created to commemorate their legend.

name: Rusty Furnace Lance
intro: A heavy black iron casing forms the exterior of this turbo lance. Its rust-streaked shell smells faintly of blood.

name: Toxic Flora
intro: A strange weapon fused by a symbiotic plant living on an abandoned turbo lance. Magical energy from the vortex furnace provides the necessary power for the plant's survival, which in turn repairs the furnace's damaged parts, ensuring that the weapon functions “normally.”

name: Brass Turbo Lance
intro: The mages of Riyado designed this special turbo lance for certain magical experiments. The core is an unstable lightning magic crystal, making its powers difficult to control but overwhelmingly strong.

name: River Monster Lance
intro: The core of the vortex furnace is fitted with the venom glands of a rare colossal fish; when stimulated by magic, it continuously spews forth vast quantities of venom.

name: Furnace Axe Lance
intro: Crafted with volcanic ore and lava, this special axe-bladed turbo lance allows the user to swing it as a two-handed weapon. The furnace's flames engulf the blade in scorching flames when swung at high speeds.

name: Budding Forest
intro: The craftsmen of Riyado attempted a completely new design with this turbo lance by pairing mutated plant material with a specially-designed magical drive mechanism, achieving a perfect fusion of biology and machinery.

name: Fine Iron Lance
intro: This refined iron turbo lance has improved performance and stability over previous models and has an additional set of experimental combat functions.

name: Malefic Alchemy Array
intro: The evil alchemist Eugene modified this turbo lance, which was actually converted from his alchemy compression device. The core contains various unstable alchemical substances, which raises concerns about potential leaks.

name: Corrosive Turbo Lance
intro: Infested by the blood and flesh of the undead, this turbo lance is powered by necrotic magic in place of its damaged core, causing the weapon to operate in an unnatural manner.

name: Frozen Furnace
intro: Craftsmen of Riyado crafted this experimental weapon after studying the mineral materials of the polar regions. This weapon is entirely made from un-meltable ice ore and uses polar saltpeter as its fuel. It can rapidly generate sharp ice blades at the lance tip by condensing the moisture in the air.

name: Explosive Claw
intro: It is said to be a turbo lance found in an abandoned sandbreaker ship in the Niter Desert. Its core is powered by a large amount of ever-burning saltpeter, making it both extremely powerful and unwieldy.

name: Noble Crystal Lance
intro: Issued to the Imperial guards for ceremonial purposes, this turbo lance is equipped with a standard steam-pressurized core, but the casing is made of fine steel and meteorite. The blade is crafted from a magic crystal, giving the weapon an excellent affinity for lightning magic.

name: Demon Spine
intro: Created from the bones and heart of a powerful Fallen Dragon, this turbo lance can temporarily awaken the dragon with a surge of magic.

name: Volcanic Fury
intro: A masterpiece created by a mad mage and craftsman, it is rumored to have a miniaturized volcano inside its core thanks to a reduction spell. Its continuous eruptions power the furnace from within.

name: Pressurized Furnace Mk III
intro: This special turbo lance was tuned by a demi-human known as the Weapon Master and has exceptional combat performance.

name: Monolith Blaster
intro: The craftsmen of Riyado used the core of a powerful creature from the Riyado mountains and refitted it with bedrock and magic crystals to create this experimental turbo lance.

name: Celadon Lance
intro: Designed by the artisans of the Far Eastern Red-Jade Empire, this experimental turbo lance is made from special ceramic materials and uses a gem bestowed by the Flame God as an energy amplifier in its core.

name: Engine of Void
intro: A turbo lance made from unique materials able to create a miniaturized black hole. Although some believe it originates from another dimension, it is most likely to be the result of research by a mysterious magical organization in Riyado.

name: Frost Engine
intro: A turbo lance powered by the energy of ice spirits, it is capable of striking enemies with the force of solid ice.

name: Soul Furnace
intro: Crafted with an unstable Soulstone as the core, this turbo lance continuously exudes the power of evil spirits attempting to escape from within.

name: Dragon Engine
intro: Using the flame sac of a fire dragon as the core, this turbo lance is driven by draconic flames, burning enemies just as the beast itself would.

name: Ritual Lance
intro: Forged with fragments of a burning meteor as the core, this turbo lance can launch attacks akin to meteor strikes.

name: Demon Destroyer
intro: An Imperial craftsman created this powerful turbo lance. Although named Demon Slayer, the core is, ironically, powered by a demon's heart.

name: Evil Ghost Hearts
intro: The experimental turbo lance built by the island nation's shipbuilders is said to have the heart of a bloodthirsty evil spirit as its core material.

name: Turbo Rocket
intro: The Imperial Grand Craftsman designed this brand-new turbo lance! It’s not just for battle, but is also useful as a mode of transportation!

name: Rustforge Halberd
intro: This eerie turbo lance was produced from the fusion of an abandoned furnace, ancient Imperial halberd fragments, and demonic flesh. The broken furnace pulses with the blood of demons, beating like a heart.

name: Freezing Breath
intro: Constructed with the crystallized power of the Ice God as its core, this turbo lance is driven by frost power and perpetually exudes a frigid aura.

name: Bombarder
intro: A turbo lance forged from enchanted brass armor and the ether power cores of Arcane Automatons. When driven at full power, it generates immense destructive force.

name: Claw of the Lord
intro: A turbo lance corrupted by the flesh and claws of the powerful Demon Lord. This weapon, amplified by demonic power, allows the user to unleash terrifying power.

name: Ruinous Blaze Forge
intro: A forge ablaze with the primordial chaotic blaze, it shall ultimately consume all life in existence.

name: Rusty Lantern
intro: A unique magical item discovered in the Ethereal Treasury. These lantern-like devices are inhabited by peculiar phantom creatures created with Ethereal magic. These Phantoms can assist the lantern's wielder and provide them with special magical powers.

name: Blade Lantern
intro: Phantoms seem to be mirrors created by the Ethereals based on the souls of certain creatures. Some Phantoms possess mighty combat skills and project various weapons in battle.

name: Wood Guardian Spirit
intro: The Phantom that harbors the powerful power of a wood spirit can channel the power of the forest to attack its enemies.

name: Old Vine Lantern
intro: By drawing venom from the lantern's toxic vines, the Phantom gains the ability to spew a miasma.

name: Ice Lantern
intro: Crafted from unmelting shards of solid ice, the Phantom can channel the power of frost magic through this lantern.

name: Steel Lantern
intro: A steel lantern that houses a Phantom... Perhaps any lantern can serve as a home for a Phantom?

name: Rock Lantern
intro: The lantern, made of thick stone, houses a phantom that may possess a body as solid as bedrock.

name: Torch of the Wilds
intro: The Phantom within projects the power of a mighty warrior, whose war cry is incredibly inspiring.

name: Lantern of Mutation
intro: In this bizarre lantern, a Phantom projects the power of a mutated priest, possessing chilling necromantic power.

name: Bait Crystal
intro: "Which ethereal came up with the idea of creating a Phantom based on the soul of a Treasure Anglerfish?"

name: River Monster Lantern
intro: This lantern appears to be made from the remains of a highly venomous river creature, and the Phantom has thus gained the traits of this bizarre beast.

name: Apprentice's Lantern
intro: The lantern contains arcane magical energy, and the Phantom can channel this power to cast stronger attacks.

name: Aged Helmet (NPC)
intro: A Phantom born from the soul of an unnamed knight. Though limited in power, it is solid and reliable.

name: Aged Helmet
intro: A Phantom born from the soul of an unnamed knight. Though limited in power, it is solid and reliable.

name: Iron Forge Lamp
intro: A Phantom that can channel the power of fire resides within this lantern. In cold places, this lantern can also serve as a heater.

name: Legion Torch
intro: The phantom born from the soul projection of a legion leader can create legion phantoms to charge into battle.

name: Lantern of Void
intro: It is said that after discovering the lantern, a secret magical society of Riyado injected gravity-manipulating void power into it, creating this special weapon.

name: Fortress Lantern
intro: This sturdy lantern is inhabited by a powerful and reliable Phantom. Perhaps this Phantom's power originates from a reliable leader the ethereals once encountered?

name: Prototype Arcane Lantern
intro: The Riyado Guardian Council, after studying the Phantom Lantern, attempted to modify it with arcane magic. The result is a lantern with a Phantom that has greater obedience and affinity for arcane magic.

name: Lightning Core
intro: The Phantom, imbued with the power of a thunder spirit, resides in this lantern and can unleash powerful lightning strikes.

name: Relic Core
intro: This Phantom grows by consuming the core power of magical puppets and can channel powerful arcane magic.

name: Frostbound Furnace
intro: A Phantom that can use the power of ice spirits.

name: Legacy of the Swordsman
intro: A Phantom projected from the soul of a legendary demon hunter. The Hunter is filled with an ominous obsession and craves the slaughter of every demon they encounter.

name: Barrier of Frost
intro: This Phantom controls the power of frost and can create icy barriers to protect its owner, granting a sense of solid reassurance.

name: Soul of the Dragon
intro: Burning with the soul of a red dragon, this Phantom can transform into a malevolent dragon to incinerate enemies.

name: Lantern of Soul
intro: A lantern made from unstable Soulstones, with an endless supply of vicious and resentful soul energy constantly seeping outwards.

name: Illusion Lantern
intro: A lantern with extremely unstable energy, it seems that infusing it with mana can also put the Phantom into an unstable state.

name: Power of the Bull
intro: The Phantom within the lantern has mutated after fusing with the soul of a beast, embodying both ferocity and instability. It seems that this fierce Phantom can also influence its master.

name: Magnetic Storm Coil
intro: The latest achievement from Riyado's finest craftsmen who studied magic energy-driven devices after researching the mysterious Phantoms.

name: Demonic Imperial Helmet
intro: A Phantom projected from the soul of a knight who was corrupted by demonic power. Despite his corruption, the knight still wields weapons with a resilient will.

name: Nightmare Puppet
intro: A Phantom Lantern infested by an otherworldly entity. Some believe the creature has merely mimicked the lantern's form. Whether the Treasure Hunters who brought it back were truly in control—or unknowingly manipulated by this sinister presence—remains a haunting enigma.

name: Eye of the Fallen Dragon
intro: Crafted from the remains of an Fallen Dragon, the Phantom within this lantern inherited the dragon's grudge and constantly drains life from its surroundings.

name: Mjolnir
intro: A Phantom created by the Ethereals by projecting the power of a deity from another world. It is capable of arming its wielder with powerful lightning Phantom energy and commanding the force of thunder.

name: Heart of the Lord
intro: A Phantom imbued with the formidable power of a Demon Lord. Under the influence of the powerful demonic force, this Phantom has an uncontrollable urge to destroy everything.

name: Shadow of Chaos
intro: A lantern inhabited by the projection of the Chaos God's power. Its shadowy essence is the very incarnation of evil, corrupting its bearer’s soul.

name: Training Katana
intro: A simple wooden katana. Generally used for training, but some overconfident Ryosen warriors often use them in combat.

name: Katana
intro: A common two-handed weapon used by the warriors of the far eastern island nation of Ryosen. Compared to other two-handed weapons that rely on brute strength, katanas emphasize skill and precision.

name: Bamboo Striker
intro: A weapon used by a quirky samurai from a far eastern island. Although it’s called a sword, it’s actually just a piece of hardened bamboo. In the hands of a samurai, it can slash like a sword, but for ordinary people, it might be better to stick to thrusting.

name: Long Branch
intro: The essence of swordsmanship lies in the wielder’s skill rather than the blade itself. Powerful swordsmen prefer to defeat enemies with their craft rather than the sharpness of their swords.

name: Serrated Blade
intro: A katana with a jagged blade. It’s still usable, but requires some special skills.

name: Spiritwood Branch
intro: A long blade formed by the entanglement of vines and branches from a magical guardian. It can channel the magic power of the guardian to attack.

name: Pickled Salted Sword
intro: Said to be an Imperial sword passed down by as a family heirloom. After being inherited (and pickled) through multiple generations, it has become tough (and flavorful).

name: Frostmoon
intro: A katana made from solid ice. Frostmoon and Solar Blaze are the weapons of a famous pair of Ryosen monster-hunting brothers. It is rumored that one of the brothers disappeared while investigating a mysterious mutation on the borders of Riyado.

name: Solar Blaze
intro: A katana forged from volcanic minerals. Frostmoon and Solar Blaze are the weapons of a famous pair of Ryosen monster-hunting brothers. Some traces of evil magic remain on the sword, possibly indicating that one of the brothers was corrupted by evil forces.

name: Alchemical Scalpel
intro: A massive scalpel designed for conducting experiments on large-scale biological specimens. The device mounted on the blade is capable of atomizing the agents contained within its reservoir, as well as injecting them directly into the body of a test subject.

name: Desert Fin Blade
intro: A long blade crafted from the sharp fins of a Treasure Anglerfish. The unique scales of the Treasure Anglerfish not only allow this blade to effortlessly cut through enemies, but also enable skilled wielders to easily burrow through sand and stone.

name: Witchcraft Fish Bone
intro: A fish bone corroded by evil power, which still bears some strange bite marks.

name: Venomous Huntblade
intro: A long sword forged from the remains of the Huntspider Matriarch. The scabbard houses the Matriarch's venom sacs, allowing the weapon to be tempered with poison.

name: Energy Blade
intro: A long blade crafted by an unknown guild of magic craftsmen in Riyado. Its blade is shaped by magical energy, but its performance seems to be unstable due to new technology.

name: Steam-Powered Saw
intro: A prototype power weapon developed by master craftsmen. After the steam-driven mechanism on the blade is activated with magical power, its saw-edged blade can vibrate at high speed.

name: Noble Katana
intro: The ceremonial katana of the Empire, made from refined steel and adorned with meteorite. Due to its composition, this blade possess excellent magical affinity and is capable of channeling lightning magic.

name: Ghost Cutter
intro: This is the legendary great sword of a famous demon hunter from the far eastern island nation of Ryosen with an immeasurable kill count. However, in the end, the sword and its owner both disappeared during a demon hunt.  This katana materialized from the Phantom's lifelong demon-slaying obsession; the original is lost to the ages.

name: Thunderclap
intro: A long sword forged from the unstable wing-claws of a thunder dragon. Its slashes can tear through the sky and summon thunderstorms.

name: Feather Slash
intro: A long sword forged from the blade-feathers of a griffin. Its feathered blade seems sharp enough to split the sky in half.

name: Beast-Head Black Blade
intro: A heavy long sword forged from black iron. It becomes a powerful weapon in the hands of a master swordsman.

name: Prajna Ichimonji
intro: One of the weapons commonly used by the Weapon Master, its blade is so sharp that it can cleave a steel helm in two with a single stroke.

name: Demon's Fang
intro: A katana with a massive blade, forged from the fangs of a powerful ancient demon. Using a specific wielding method, it can unleash powerful demonic energy.

name: Heavy Crystal Katana
intro: A long katana forged from blood-red crystals of extremely high density, capable of striking with immense force.

name: Reaper’s Slice
intro: A famed sword rumored to be inhabited by a wind spirit, this blade can create a vortex of wind as sharp as a razor.

name: Dragon Flame
intro: A katana whose blade is forged from volcanic flame-iron, quenched in the flames of a fire dragon, and adorned with fire dragon scales. A strike infused with its power can even ignite the earth.

name: Permafrost
intro: A frozen long sword forged from polar un-melting ice ore, whose chilling aura can freeze the surrounding air.

name: Soul Crystal Blade
intro: A katana forged with unstable Soulstones, which constantly emit chaotic soul energy and inflame resentment among the dead.

name: Blade of Wind
intro: Face the wind!

name: Puppet Weaving Needle
intro: A grotesquely shaped giant weaving needle, forged from substances that should not exist and exuding an eerie aura from the depths of nightmares.

name: Nightmare Edge
intro: A grotesque long sword composed of unstable magical energy. When wielded, it constantly releases elemental power.

name: Demon Spine Sword
intro: A sword forged from the spine of a powerful demon. Infusing it with magic awakens the dormant demon's power within, allowing it to cut down everything in sight.

name: Ghost Muramasa
intro: A sharp katana forged from Soulstones corrupted by malice. Its blade exudes an ominous evil aura, yet it remains shockingly stable. This sort of power is even more terrifying as it seems to control the wielder's body and mind.

name: Marrow of Fallen Dragon
intro: Crafted from the remains of an Fallen Dragon, this blade inherited the dragon's grudge and constantly drains life from its surroundings.

name: Chaos Reaper
intro: Forged with the power of the Chaos God via a corrupted high-density Soul Crystal, it can slice apart its target’s soul and scatter it into nothingness.

name: Tracker’s Mask
intro: The secret agents of the Riyado Guardian Council often conduct covert investigations, but their disguises cannot fully conceal their profound expertise in magic.

name: (Dummy)
intro: (Dummy)

name: Village Prophet’s Outfit
intro: Every remote village seems to have eccentric seers with a bit of influence among the villagers. They believe that garlic and onions offer the best path to get closer to the divine.

name: Mercenary Mage’s Robes
intro: The borders of Riyado are home to many mage mercenaries who work for money, specializing in using magic to solve various "problems" for their clients.

name: Wandering Mage’s Robes
intro: As a nation of mages, Riyado attracts wizards from every country. Some are pursuing careers but have yet to find their place, while others enjoy the nation’s atmosphere and travel around the kingdom. These ubiquitous wandering mages are common within the nation.

name: Guardian’s Black Robes
intro: Riyado is governed by the Guardian Council, whose members use robes and masks to signify hierarchy among its members. Black robes and brass owl masks are the identifying marks of the lower-tier council mages.

name: Corrupt Clergy Robes
intro: When facing a devastating catastrophe, an old priest from a small village on the border abandoned his faith and responded to the call of an evil deity. Ultimately, the evil deity "saved" that village... at the cost of every villager’s soul.

name: Evil Alchemy Robes
intro: The evil alchemist Eugene was once a black-robed guardian of Riyado, and these peculiar robes, as it is known, were transformed from the guardian's black robes he used to wear.

name: Rain-Bringer
intro: In the remote areas of eastern countries, there is a group of marvelous traveling witches who often wear odd masks and cast spells to bring bountiful harvests to the villages they pass.

name: War Pastor’s Uniform
intro: This uniform is worn by battlefield priests of the Empire's high-ranking knights. These warrior priests are not only able to heal the wounded through prayer and miracles on the battlefield, but they are also more than capable of holding their own on the battlefield.

name: Sorcery Soldier’s Robes
intro: The short robes worn by the lower-ranking soldiers of the Imperial Magic Troops. Even these soldiers can use magic to aid in combat.

name: Sacramental Robes
intro: The long robes of the Empire's clergy are commonly seen on the holy priests of the Empire.

name: Fallen Apprentice’s Robes
intro: Riyado, known as a nation of magic, has various official magical organizations and societies as well as many clandestine societies that engage in the forbidden study of dark magic.

name: Aged Maid Outfit
intro: "Truly, truly sorry!"

name: Fishbone Mask
intro: A mask crafted from fish bones, worn by the shamans of the Mudfish Tribe. Imbued with eerie magical power, it subtly warps the wearer's psyche, blurring the line between reality and hallucination.

name: Santa Claus
intro: Merry Christmas!

name: Guardian’s Gray Robes
intro: The robes of the mages from Rhea Multa's Guardian Council. Gray robes and silver owl masks are the insignia of the mid-tier council mages.

name: Werther's Fraudulent Robes
intro: The previous owner of these robes was a famous con artist who was exiled by the Empire. The mouth on the hat appears to have the power to bewitch the minds of others.

name: Thunderbolt Robes
intro: In the past, a powerful thunder spirit fell in love with a young mage who was practicing in the mountains. However, the mountains were just one stop on the young mage's journey. Before parting, the thunder spirit blessed the mage's robes with its potent energy.

name: Melancholy Pumpkin
intro: This is a sentient pumpkin that does not know why it exists or where it should go. After some consideration, it hopes that you put it on your head and travel with it.

name: Netherworld Robes
intro: The far eastern island nation of Ryosen’s secret magical society don robes with a white fox insignia, symbolizing mystery and spirituality.

name: Evil Scarecrow
intro: Malice seems to lurk within the straw, enough to scare away any timid soul… but it might just attract powerful monsters to come after you.

name: Polar Wizard's Garb
intro: A robe worn by wizards from the extremely cold regions. It is more akin to a thick winter coat than a standard robe.

name: Runed Robes of Nairu
intro: The robes woven by the Nairu Ethereals have wisdom and magical power flowing through every thread.

name: Blue Rune Robe
intro: A robe imbued with pure Nairu rune power.

name: Ruby Mage's Robes
intro: The Redstone Society is an independent and neutral mage organization that focuses on the study of magic and its history. Its members often gather for expeditions in and around magical ruins.

name: High Wizard’s Mask
intro: The mages of the Far Eastern Red-Jade Empire are skilled at channeling natural magical forces. In addition to using various these forces to defeat enemies in war, they also use their powers to pray for favorable weather.

name: Augur’s Robes
intro: The forest demi-humans possess a strong affinity for natural magic, and some of the most distinguished among them can even communicate with nature to divine the future.

name: Arcane Battle Robes
intro: The non-commissioned officers in the Imperial Magic Troops are powerful combat mages skilled in using various battle spells to crush the Empire's enemies.

name: White Mage’s Robes
intro: White mages are adept at using various types of support magic. In the magic nation of Riyado, these robes belong to those non-council white mages who have reached masterful levels of magical prowess.

name: Black Mage’s Robes
intro: The robes of a black mage are not worn by a practitioner of evil magic, but rather by a mage who specializes in various offensive magic spells. In the nation of Riyado, those wearing these black robes are often the most powerful of all battle mages.

name: Rebel Lord's Robes
intro: These robes once belonged to a border lord who wanted to overthrow the Olias Empire. It has a demon power core embedded in each shoulder, possessing strong but unstable evil powers.

name: Vampire Costume
intro: Wearing this costume, you can almost feel the call of the night, exuding an aura of mystery and danger.

name: Frozen Robe
intro: A robe said to have been worn by a famous eccentric mage. He believed that to achieve higher magical prowess, one must first have a calm mind. Thus, he cast a peculiar spell on his robe, encasing the wearer's head in ice.

name: Phantom Feather Robe
intro: This robe is adorned with numerous raven feathers and is said to have once belonged to a legendary mage proficient in Ethereal flame magic.

name: Ominous Maid Outfit
intro: A bizarre maid costume that exudes an ominous aura, despite showing no traces of being corrupted by demons.

name: Nightmare Robe
intro: A grotesque robe composed of unstable magical energy, seemingly with its mana capable of devouring the robe's wearer.

name: Guardian’s White Robes
intro: The robes of a Riyado Guardian Council mage. White robes and a golden owl mask signify a high-ranking council mage. The robes enhance the wearer's magical affinity, as if blessed by the god Hilal himself.

name: Sky Pyromaniac
intro: These robes belonged to a famous mage from the Eastern Red-Jade Empire in the past. The powerful enchantment brings great power to the wearer, but how these robes appeared in a border region is unknown.

name: Legendary Mage’s Robes
intro: The robes left behind by a legendary black mage who became an Ethereal being. They carry the immense energy of their previous owner. Even the Ethereals treasure it as a precious artifact.

name: Void Arcane Robe
intro: A mysterious robe woven from threads of Ethereal rune magic. Yet beyond its pure Ethereal runic essence, Chaos power seems to lie hidden within the fabric.
