name: Basic Clothing
intro: People don't always wear armor, and Treasure Hunters are no exception.

name: Hunter’s Armor
intro: A type of light leather armor that is widely worn among explorers. It is lightweight and provides a certain level of basic protection, but is not a great choice for battling powerful monsters.

name: Trainee Hunter’s Light Armor
intro: This modified light armor performs similarly to an ordinary hunter's light armor.

name: Wood Elf’s Tree Clothes
intro: In the elven settlements along the borders of Riyado, young elven hunters often wear “tree garments.” These garments are made from leather and special bark, vines, and leaves. The tree garment's primary feature is to help its wearer blend into the forest.

name: Explorer’s Armor
intro: Lightweight leather armor that is sewn from leather and linen for ease of movement. The materials suggest its functionality might be far greater than its protective qualities.

name: Imperial Soldier’s Armor
intro: The standard infantry armor for the lower ranks of the Empire. Its greatest feature is its lightness and comfort when marching.

name: Swordsman’s Leather Armor
intro: The hooded leather armor worn by an unknown wandering swordsman. At the nation's border, there are many such unnamed swordsmen who hunt demons for bounties.

name: Soldier’s Uniform
intro: Typically worn by the crew or scouts of the far eastern island nation of Ryosen, this light armor is made from linen and woven grass.

name: Spy's Robes
intro: The official light armor of Imperial spies. Due to the high recognizability of the black hoods and white armor, it is usually only worn during formal occasions and certain public operations.

name: Gardener's Work Clothes
intro: There are many mysterious monsters around the Black Castle, and this powerful monster, known as the Gardener, seems to have some connection to the castle's past…

name: Victor's Battle Clothes
intro: The Goblin Legion crafted a splendid suit of battle attire for their proud and mighty champion, but they completely overlooked taking measurements to ensure their champion could fit into it.

name: Lost Puppet Costume
intro: Once, a Goblin King had a cute doggy that he had raised from a pup. To keep the doggy from feeling lonely, the king often wore this puppet costume that matched the doggy to play with it… What, you’re saying this puppet outfit doesn't look at all like a doggy? Well, that's how the documents are written. Translating goblin literature is hard!

name: Guard’s Armor
intro: This chainmail is typically worn by the town guards of Riyado. While the heavy iron helmet provides some protection for the head, the simple materials only offer basic protection against powerful monsters.

name: Ceremonial Jacket
intro: The ceremonial garb of the Olias Empire is more decorative than practical.

name: Light Combat Armor
intro: In the border regions, light and practical leather armor is popular among swordsmen from the East, with its lightness and utility as its main draws.

name: Bandit’s Armor
intro: Bandits in the border areas often raid passing caravans. Many bandits prefer light armor to more quickly escape after looting.

name: Broker’s Hat
intro: Working as a broker in the border regions is a dangerous occupation. Hats and leather jackets made from specially treated monster hides offer a small degree of defense.

name: Footman’s Armor
intro: The standard armor for lower-ranking soldiers of the Eastern Red-Jade Empire is lightweight and provides a fair level of protection.

name: Hill Elf’s Clothes
intro: Ancient Wood Elf mountain dwellers often dwell in the border regions so as to worship nature away from civilization.

name: Wanderer’s Leather Armor
intro: Leather armor worn by some of the lower-class wandering mercenaries in the border areas. The leather hoods protect against all but the harshest weather.

name: Scary Doll Costume
intro: "Trick or Treat!"

name: Devouring Armor
intro: Leather armor crafted from the materials of the Treasure Anglerfish. Putting it on is said to inspire hunger in its wearer.

name: Ranger's Attire
intro: The ranger organization's high-end outfit is both glamorous and practical.

name: Cloud-Pattern Helmet
intro: Crafted by Red-Jade artisans, the armor of the high-level light cavalry of the Red-Jade Empire is lightweight and has excellent defensive capabilities.

name: Swordsman’s Robes
intro: The wandering warriors of the Red-Jade Empire favor this attire, vanishing after performing acts of chivalry in order to conceal their identities and reputations.

name: Thief’s Hood
intro: The enchanted hoods that have recently become popular among thieves' organizations are such that when you wear the hood and mask together, no one can see your face clearly. (Seriously?)

name: Dark Iron Armor
intro: The standard armor worn by lower-ranking officers of the Eastern Red-Jade Empire offers better defensive capabilities than the infantry armor.

name: Turtle Armor
intro: Armor made from the shells of Missile Turtles. While one would think that the shells would be imposing, it somehow manages to be somewhat cute!

name: Short Furry Robe
intro: A famous treasure hunter adept skilled in multiple weapon styles wore these robes. Although the robes appear ordinary, they contain various mechanisms to assist in combat.

name: Cursed Barbarian Armor
intro: The bone and hide armor worn by a brutal exiled brutal barbarian leader. It is rumored that this armor is cursed, capable of transferring the defeated enemies’ power to the wearer.

name: Mystic Swordsman Coat
intro: The costume of a Ryosen warrior with a spirit fox mask. It is said to possess the power to ward off evil and drive away demons.

name: Akhil Runic Armor
intro: Forged by the Akhil Ethereals, this armor is said to fill the body of the wearer with courage and strength.

name: Broker’s Flashy Outfit
intro: In the border regions, being a broker is a dangerous yet profitable profession. If your business is booming, you might need this flashy suit to keep you safe.

name: White Bat Boneplate
intro: The Batwing Knights are a famous demon-hunting organization. The white bat bone armor that features their insignia is extremely light and agile, despite being a full-body set.

name: Ethereal Cloak
intro: This mystical cloak enchanted by the Ethereals seems to be able to channel the power of Ethereal magic.

name: Watcher’s Armor
intro: The Watchers are an independent special operations organization within the Riyado Guardian Council, mainly responsible for punishing various abusers of magic and overseeing the rest of the Council.

name: Dragon Skin Armor
intro: Crafted from the shed skin of young dragons, this armor is effective in resisting magical attacks.

name: Shadow Lurker
intro: The outfit of the infamous Shadow assassin organization that worships Viskalo, the Lord of Shadows. They’re known for their proficiency in magic and alchemy.

name: Malicious Mask
intro: This mask originates from a sinister alchemical cult's set. Due to frequent engagement in perilous alchemical experiments, members of the cult often wear chilling beaked masks, and their clothing is made from leather with protective properties.

name: Storm Captain's Armor
intro: The armor of the captain of the Storm Mercenary Corps, who worship Carrion the Storm God. This regiment is renowned for their expertise with javelins and other throwing weapons.

name: Red Rune Armor
intro: An armor imbued with pure Akhil rune power.

name: Holy Warrior
intro: This powerful armor emits a holy golden glow. It may have been collected by the Ethereals from powerful demon slayers from another time and place.

name: Carapace of the Lord
intro: Armor enveloped in an evil black mist. When worn, it can convert Ethereal rune power to activate a powerful demonic force. However, the Guild suspects that excessive use of demonic power carries the risk of being corrupted or possessed by the demon.

name: Insidious Chaos Armor
intro: In ancient Riyado legends, the insidious Chaos God once tempted mankind, driving them to madness and endless strife. True to the tales, this armor brims with chaotic power that twists all who wear it into insanity.

name: Infantry Armor
intro: Heavy armor popular among mercenaries of various nations. Crafted from heavy cast iron, it offers superior defensive capabilities against powerful monsters.

name: Spirit Vine Armor
intro: Armor made of spirit tree bark and vines, with the vitality of life itself imbuing the wearer with energy.

name: Northern Heavy Armor
intro: Plate armor worn by the brave knights of the northern regions, adorned with fur from northern animals for a unique appearance and extra warmth.

name: Worn Knight’s Armor
intro: Armor of lower-ranking knights. Though seemingly well-maintained without much rust, the wear and tear speak of its age and history.

name: Bastion Heavy Armor
intro: Sturdy armor enveloping the body with hard minerals, effectively warding off physical attacks.

name: Samurai’s Armor
intro: Warrior armor from the far eastern island nation of Ryosen, made from ironwood. Very solid.

name: Wandering Knight’s Armor
intro: Knights who have abandoned their original organizations work as treasure hunters or mercenaries on the frontier and cover their armor with robes and burlap to hide the emblems of past affiliations.

name: Soul-Devouring Armor
intro: The armor of a knight who failed to fulfill his vow to protect his village. He became a monster, killing the very people he swore to protect. The armor he once wore has transformed into a sinister object that devours souls.

name: Wasteland Hooligan
intro: Some wandering gangs have taken up residence in the border region’s deserts. Like the Lizardmen, they mainly rely on looting and scavenging for survival.

name: Wasteland Rust Armor
intro: Armor made from the steel plates of broken sand ships, covered with rust saltpeter shards.

name: Swamp Stalker Armor
intro: Armor forged from the dense carapace of the Huntspider Matriarch. Her specialized glands secrete anabolic hormones that augment the wearer's physical prowess.

name: Eagle Guardian
intro: Imperial knights’ "Eagle Guardian" standard plate armor. Provides excellent protection to the user while remaining agile and flexible.

name: Iron Knight Armor
intro: Constructed from thick iron plates, a practical suit of armor covering the whole body. It effectively withstands most attacks.

name: Ghost Warrior’s Armor
intro: Enchanted armor from the far eastern island nation of Ryosen, imbued with the power of ghosts.

name: Evil God’s Armor
intro: The armor of an evil god worshiped by an ancient sinister country. Its putrid power has faded, but the wearer can still hear the deity’s whispers.

name: Red-Lined Dark Armor
intro: Armor for mid-ranking warriors of the Far Eastern Red-Jade Empire, crafted from hard black iron and offering superb defensive capabilities.

name: Molten Knight’s Armor
intro: Unlike the Ironforge Knights, the Molten Iron Knights are not as passionate as their armor, forming a cold-blooded and merciless mercenary order.

name: Mage Killer
intro: The Mage Killers, a legion formed by the old Empire to combat the Riyado Legions, strike fear in the heart of magic users. Their armor is specially crafted to resist spells, and all members wear protective masks.

name: Rock Solid Armor
intro: Armor made of magically solidified sturdy rocks, possessing excellent defensive and arcane affinity, but lacking in mobility.

name: Rotten Scale Armor
intro: Armor forged from the scales of a corrupted dragon. The blood of the fallen beast and its energy still flow within the armor’s scales.

name: Mechanized Ice Armor
intro: A suit of armor with special magical mechanisms infused with the blood of an ice spirit.

name: Parati Runic Armor
intro: Runic armor crafted by the Parati Ethreals that allows the wearer to feel the pure force of life.

name: Paladin's Armor
intro: Enchanted armor of the Empire's elite holy knights, typically worn only by the loyalest and most senior knights of the Imperial Order.

name: Demon Slayer’s Armor
intro: It is rumored that a legendary demon hunter made this plate armor from the bodies of his kills. It radiates a chilling intent to kill when facing the demonic.

name: Ironforge Knight’s Armor
intro: The Ironforge Knight Order, well-renowned on the continent, continuously dispense justice and righteousness. They perpetually radiate their passion towards those around them, both spiritually and physically.

name: Black Knight’s Armor
intro: Mysterious black armor worn by members of the Black Knight Order, known for their dragon-slaying skills. Although their movements are hard to track, people occasionally witness these knights exchanging the heads of dragons for bounties at the Monster Hunters Guild.

name: Bull Shackles
intro: Armor forged from the enchanted steel of strong siege minotaurs. Incredibly durable and tough.

name: Golden Knight’s Armor
intro: Elegant and extremely tough armor made of special metals, with a fantastic affinity for magic.

name: Blood Knight’s Armor
intro: Special armor made from blood-red magic crystals and fine steel. The powerful magic crystals greatly enhance the constitution of the wearer, but their instability makes the defense properties unimpressive.

name: Armor of the Forgotten
intro: The princess of an ancient kingdom had a loyal guardian knight. The warrior stood by his ward for years, protecting her through thick and thin. This is that forgotten guardian's armor.

name: Green Rune Armor
intro: An armor imbued with pure Parati rune power.

name: Fallen Knight’s Armor
intro: Armor heavily corroded by demonic flesh, belonging to a very ancient order of Imperial knights. Its master seems to be a renegade knight whose name is long lost to history. The armor has been corrupted by the power of demons, and the wearer can faintly hear their whispers.

name: Enchanted Brass Armor
intro: A heavy plate armor forged from the outer shells of Riyado Arcane Automatons, boasting excellent defensive capabilities and mana-enhancing effects.

name: Keeper Armor
intro: The Keepers are a mysterious organization of unknown size. They are rumored to have entered into a contract with a powerful deity to serve as its proxy in this world. Their deal has bestowed them with great power, but it is not easily controlled by ordinary people.

name: Great Beast's Armor
intro: Armor of the Great General of the Far Eastern Red-Jade Empire, with unmatched defensive power and the blessing of the Flame God. The wearer can feel the momentum of a thousand troops coursing through the armor

name: Sinful Lord Heavy Robe
intro: Cursed Archmage Lord's robe. Its curse make it unbearably heavy, threatening to devour its wearer.

<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to draw a powerful Bomb! The bomb’s explosion triggers <uniform id=Debuff_Explosion> effect.

<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to place down an unstable explosive barrel; press <sprite key=Interaction> to kick it away quickly before detonation!

The alchemists of Riyado keep cooking up these volatile contraptions.

<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to jump. Each type of weapon has a different jumping attack action.

With those on, Treasure Hunters can even leap over each others' heads! Amazing!

<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to throw this special throwing weapon.

Forged from magic-affinity materials, it gains elemental enchantment based on the treasures in your backpack.

name: Emergency HP Bottle
intro:
<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to drink the healing potion which will gradually restore <uniform id=HP_Icon>. This potion can only be consumed once per valid area.

The healing effect is mediocre but reliable. An indispensable last resort during perilous adventures.

name: Emergency MP Bottle
intro:
<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to drink this potion to restore <uniform id=MP_Icon>.

Popular among Riyado Mages. You can even cast the Magic Burst spell at will!

name: Weapon Sling
intro:
Allows Treasure Hunters to carry a secondary weapon.

<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to switch to the secondary weapon and perform a Switch Attack.

name: Portable Magic Turret
intro:
A light, portable turret made with Riyado magic. A good partner on adventures!

* The Portable Magic Turret is considered a <uiColor name=valueUpColor>Summoned Creature</color>, and its <sprite name=UI_Text_AtrrHP><uniform id=HP_Icon> and <sprite name=UI_Text_AtrrATK><uniform id=Atk> are influenced by the current Treasure Hunter's <uniform id=Stat_Red_Base0><uniform id=Stat_Green_Base0><uniform id=Stat_Blue_Base0>.

name: Miraculous Banana Vine
intro:
<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to eat a banana and restore a small amount of <uniform id=HP_Icon>. The banana vine grows 4 bananas for each valid <uniform id=Room> passed through, with a maximum of 12 bananas on this vine.

“Don't throw banana peels around! Okay, guess no one is listening.”

name: Magic-Powered Frisbee
intro:
<sprite key=L_ActiveItem> to pull out a Magic-Powered Frisbee.

<color=#E0A745FF>Magic-Powered Frisbee</color> can only be duplicated up to <color=#DFFEFFFF>3</color> times by the retrieval effect of Treasure <color=#E0A745FF><sprite name=UI_Text_RecycleGloves>Recycling Gloves</color>. When exceeding the duplication limit, the earliest spawned Frisbees will despawn automatically.

A newly developed combat tool by Riyado's craftsmen, capable of converting incoming force into kinetic energy for spinning attacks.

name: Freeze Bomb
intro:
<sprite key=L_ActiveItem>to draw a bomb that can freeze enemies into solid blocks of ice!

Brand new flash-freezing technology! If one doesn't do the trick, try another!

name: Huge Snowball
